rules.prepare:
export PKG_CONFIG="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-pkg-config"
# As in Debian, the native debuggers have no system root and only the one of # the target reads the files in /etc/gdb. For the cross debugger, the target # is the root folder of the build box. It looks for the debug symbols of the # target in /usr/lib/debug, not in lib/debug of its prefix, the sysroot is # not put in front of it when looking a file up by its build ID. case "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" in cross-tools) EXTRA_OPTS="--with-sysroot=/" EXTRA_OPTS="$EXTRA_OPTS --with-separate-debug-dir=/usr/lib/debug" ;; tools) EXTRA_OPTS="--program-prefix=${AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE}-" ;; *) EXTRA_OPTS="--with-system-gdbinit=/etc/gdb/gdbinit" EXTRA_OPTS="$EXTRA_OPTS --with-system-gdbinit-dir=/etc/gdb/gdbinit.d" ;; esac
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" CFLAGS="$CFLAGS -fPIC" \ CXXFLAGS="$CXXFLAGS -fPIC" \ "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure" \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --libexecdir="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gdb" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --target="$AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE" \ --disable-maintainer-mode \ --disable-gdbtk \ --disable-shared \ --disable-readline \ --disable-sim \ --disable-source-highlight \ --enable-64-bit-bfd \ --enable-tui \ --without-babeltrace \ --without-debuginfod \ --without-guile \ --without-intel-pt \ --with-system-readline \ --with-expat \ --with-system-zlib \ --with-lzma \ --with-xxhash \ --with-python="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/python3" \ --disable-nls \ $EXTRA_OPTS
rules.install:
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------- # SETUP # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
if [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" = "cross-tools" ]; then PROGRAM_PREFIX_FROM="${AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE}-" PROGRAM_PREFIX_TO="" elif [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" = "tools" ]; then PROGRAM_PREFIX_FROM="${AELTRA_TARGET_TYPE}-" PROGRAM_PREFIX_TO="$PROGRAM_PREFIX_FROM" else PROGRAM_PREFIX_FROM="" PROGRAM_PREFIX_TO="" fi
FULL_INSTALL="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/all"
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make DESTDIR="$FULL_INSTALL" install
find "$FULL_INSTALL" -name "*.la" -exec rm '{}' \; rm -fr "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/info" rm -fr "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/man"
# The headers and static libraries of bfd, opcodes, ctf and sframe, which come # with the sources of gdb. Debian has them in binutils-dev. rm -f "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/include/"*.h rm -f "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/"*.a
# gdbserver is packaged for the target only, and the cross debugger takes the # files of gdb-common from tools-gdb-common. if [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" != "target" ]; then rm -f "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/"*gdbserver rm -fr "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib" fi
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------- PKG_PATH="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/gdb" # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
install -d -m 0755 "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin"
for PROG in gcore gdb gdb-add-index gstack; do if [ -e "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/$PROGRAM_PREFIX_FROM$PROG" ]; then mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/$PROGRAM_PREFIX_FROM$PROG" \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/$PROGRAM_PREFIX_TO$PROG" fi done
if [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" = "target" ]; then install -d -m 0755 "$PKG_PATH/etc/gdb/gdbinit.d" echo "# System-wide GDB initialization file." \ > "$PKG_PATH/etc/gdb/gdbinit" chmod 0644 "$PKG_PATH/etc/gdb/gdbinit" fi
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------- PKG_PATH="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/gdb-common" # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
install -d -m 0755 "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX"
for SUBDIR in share include; do mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$SUBDIR" \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/" done
if [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" = "cross-tools" ]; then rm -fr "$PKG_PATH" fi
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------- PKG_PATH="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/gdbserver" # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
install -d -m 0755 "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin"
for PROG in gdbserver; do if [ -e "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/$PROG" ]; then mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/$PROG" \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin" fi done
for SUBDIR in lib; do if [ -d "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$SUBDIR" ]; then mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/$SUBDIR" \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/" fi done
